history.title: യാത്ര തുടങ്ങുന്നു (The Trip Begins)
history.summary: Sachin holds a map, looking excited. Renu is surprised. Sachin packs unnecessary items.
history.cliffhanger: Renu points at a woman on the road. Sachin looks back. Dialogue: 'ആ സ്ത്രീ ആരാണ്?'

history.title: മൂടൽമഞ്ഞിലെ വീട് (The Cottage in the Mist)
history.summary: Stranded in the dense fog, Amal spots a dim light from an old cottage tucked away in the tea plantations. An elderly woman welcomes them inside to wait out the night. The tension spikes when the old woman instantly guesses that Reenu saw the woman on the road and warns them never to travel there after sunset.
history.cliffhanger: A freezing handprint slowly presses against the outer window glass from the dark outside.

history.title: ഇരുട്ടിലെ മന്ത്രിപ്പുകൾ (Whispers in the Dark)
history.summary: As the elderly woman panics and barricades the back door, Sachin tries to demand answers about who is outside. The old woman reveals a dark local tragedy from decades ago involving a tea picker wronged by the estate owners. Amal panics and tries to sneak out the front window to find help.
history.cliffhanger: Amal opens the front window, only to find the cottage surrounded by an impenetrable wall of glowing white mist and echoing footsteps.

history.title: ചിത്രത്തിലെ രഹസ്യം (The Portrait's Secret)
history.summary: Driven back inside by the freezing, unnatural fog, Amal joins Sachin and Reenu as they inspect the cottage's interior. Reenu notices an old, dust-covered oil painting on the wall that depicts the exact woman standing outside in the mist. The old woman confesses a chilling truth: the spirit is looking for a descendant of the estate owners, and she believes Reenu holds her face.
history.cliffhanger: The painting's eyes in the portrait suddenly shift to look directly at Sachin, and the room's temperature drops to freezing.

history.title: തകർന്ന യുക്തി (Shattered Logic)
history.summary: Desperate for a rational explanation, Sachin tries to check the cottage's fuse box in the dark hallway, refusing to believe the supernatural threat. Shadows stretch unnaturally along the walls, and the old tea estate's historical logbook flies open by itself. Reenu pulls a terrified Sachin away just as the hallway ceiling collapses in a cloud of dust.
history.cliffhanger: Flipped pages of the logbook reveal a final entry written in fresh red ink with Reenu's exact name.

history.title: എസ്റ്റേറ്റ് അവശിഷ്ടങ്ങൾ (The Estate Ruins)
history.summary: The old woman tells them the only way to appease the spirit before dawn is to find her locket buried at the nearby abandoned tea factory ruins. Sachin, Reenu, and Amal brave the terrifying fog-filled path outside, holding a single flickering lantern. Every shadow looks like a moving figure as whispers call out their names from the tea bushes.
history.cliffhanger: Amal steps into a hidden ditch, and when Sachin and Reenu turn around to pull him up, Amal has completely vanished.

history.title: തേയിലച്ചെടികൾക്കിടയിലെ ശബ്ദങ്ങൾ (Voices in the Tea Bushes)
history.summary: Left with only each other, Sachin and Reenu frantically search the misty plantation for Amal. Reenu hears Amal's voice calling for help deeper into the maze of tea plants, but Sachin urges her not to follow the trap. Guided by her intuition, Reenu breaks away, forcing Sachin to chase after her into the heart of the ruins.
history.cliffhanger: They find Amal sitting inside the decaying factory office, staring blankly at a wall with a spectral hand resting on his shoulder.

history.title: മാലയുടെ ശാപം (The Locket's Curse)
history.summary: Sachin snaps Amal out of his trance, and together they discover the rusted silver locket buried beneath the factory floorboards. The phantom woman manifests before them, blocking the exit with a furious wall of wind and swirling mist. Sachin steps in front of Reenu, abandoning his skepticism to plead for her safety.
history.cliffhanger: The spirit reaches out a cold hand, ignoring Sachin entirely and grabbing Reenu's wrist with terrifying force.

history.title: പുലർച്ചെയുടെ വെളിച്ചം (Dawn's Breaking Light)
history.summary: Holding the locket, Reenu looks past the ghost's anger and speaks with deep empathy, recognizing the pain of the injustice she suffered. The spirit's form softens as the first rays of dawn break over the Munnar hills, burning away the supernatural mist. The curse is broken, and the spirit finally fades away in peace.
history.cliffhanger: The three friends collapse onto the grass as the sun fully rises, revealing their car parked safely on a normal, clear road with fixed tires.

season_arc.synopsis: Sachin surprises Reenu with a Munnar trip, but things go south when he forgets the essential permits and Amal mocks his 'perfect' map skills. As they drive into the high ranges, Sachin mistakenly enters a restricted forest route into the GPS.
season_arc.cliffhanger: As the mist thickens, Reenu spots a woman in a white saree standing by the cliffside, but she vanishes the moment Sachin looks back.

season_arc.synopsis: The trio stops at a lonely tea shop where the owner warns them against taking the old forest road after dark. Amal laughs off the 'ghost story' until the car suddenly stalls in the middle of a pitch-black stretch of woods.
season_arc.cliffhanger: While Sachin checks the engine, Reenu looks at the car window's reflection and sees the woman standing right behind Sachin's shoulder.

season_arc.synopsis: They arrive at a creepy homestay managed by Sreedharan, who strictly forbids them from approaching the locked room at the end of the hallway. Sachin and Amal’s curiosity gets the better of them as they hear rhythmic tapping coming from inside the room at midnight.
season_arc.cliffhanger: As they lean against the door to listen, the heavy iron lock clicks open on its own and the door slowly creaks inward.

season_arc.synopsis: Inside the room, they find an old photograph of the woman they saw on the road standing in front of the same house. Sachin tries to debunk the mystery with logic, but Amal notices the woman in the photo is now looking directly at them.
season_arc.cliffhanger: The lights flicker and die; when they come back on, two more shadowy figures have appeared behind the woman in the photograph.

season_arc.synopsis: Following a trail in the tea plantation for a photoshoot, the group finds an abandoned tea-processing unit filled with rusted machinery. They discover a dusty notebook belonging to a woman named Bhadra, detailing her fear of someone following her.
season_arc.cliffhanger: A chilling female voice echoes through the hollow metal pipes of the factory, clearly whispering Reenu's name.

season_arc.synopsis: Amal attempts to lighten the mood by using a 'ghost detector' app on his phone, leading to slapstick comedy as he jumps at his own shadow. However, the humor ends when they find fresh, wet footprints leading from the factory floor directly to their car.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Reenu opens the car door and finds a handwritten note on her seat that reads: 'Don't go to the old bridge tomorrow.'

season_arc.synopsis: Ignoring the warning, Reenu leads the boys to the dilapidated colonial bridge mentioned in the notebook. They find a broken locket caught in the wooden planks, but the mist becomes so dense they lose sight of each other.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Bhadra appears inches away from Reenu, whispering 'He is still here' just as a massive crash sounds from the nearby woods.

season_arc.synopsis: A sudden landslide traps them in an old estate building for the night with no signal. While searching for a way out, they find a hidden floorboard containing letters that implicate Sreedharan in a decades-old cover-up regarding Bhadra.
season_arc.cliffhanger: The door to their room is violently kicked open from the outside, but no one is standing there—only a cold wind.

season_arc.synopsis: They confront Sreedharan back at the homestay, who breaks down and admits he witnessed Bhadra's accident but was paid to stay silent. He warns them that Bhadra isn't seeking revenge on them, but trying to prevent another 'accident' tonight.
season_arc.cliffhanger: The lights go out completely, and they hear the heavy, dragging footsteps of someone—or something—approaching from the forest.

season_arc.synopsis: The trio makes a run for the car as the estate structure begins to fail during the storm. Bhadra’s spirit appears one last time, not to scare them, but to point toward the only safe path out of the crumbling plantation before the final landslide hits.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Safe at the city limits, Amal checks his phone gallery; the final selfie shows Bhadra standing behind their car, smiling peacefully as she fades away.

episodes.synopsis: Stranded in the dense fog, Amal spots a dim light from an old cottage tucked away in the tea plantations. An elderly woman welcomes them inside to wait out the night. The tension spikes when the old woman instantly guesses that Reenu saw the woman on the road and warns them never to travel there after sunset.
episodes.cliffhanger: Three violent knocks echo from the back door, and Reenu peeks through the curtain to see the mysterious woman staring directly at the old woman.

Reenu pulls a terrified Sachin away just as the hallway ceiling collapses in a cloud of dust.

Every shadow looks like a moving figure as whispers call out their names from the tea bushes.

The central dramatic question is resolved as their bond is forged stronger through terror and survival, leaving the mist behind them forever.

episodes.synopsis: Desperate for a rational explanation, Sachin tries to check the cottage's fuse box in the dark hallway, refusing to believe the supernatural threat. Every shadow looks like a moving figure as whispers call out their names from the tea bushes.

episodes.synopsis: Relieved and exhausted, Sachin, Reenu, and Amal drive back down toward Kochi, processing the unbelievable events of the night. The central dramatic question is resolved as their bond is forged stronger through terror and survival, leaving the mist behind them forever.

episodes.synopsis: Sachin holds a map, looking excited. Renu is surprised. Sachin packs unnecessary items.
episodes.cliffhanger: Renu points at a woman on the road. Sachin looks back. Dialogue: 'ആ സ്ത്രീ ആരാണ്?'

shots.speaker: Narrator
shots.action: A wide, warm Pixar-style cinematic shot of a cozy Munnar living room bathed in golden morning mist filtering through large glass windows. Sachin stands center-stage, bursting with infectious energy, clutching a weathered, hand-drawn map with dramatic flair. He points excitedly at a circled location. Reenu sits on a vintage wooden sofa nearby, sipping chaya from a clay cup, pausing mid-sip with a raised eyebrow and an amused, skeptical smile, looking at a packed suitcase by the door.
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up with expressive emotional focus

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Close-up on Sachin as he springs across the cozy living room in a exaggerated, theatrical glide, planting both hands on the coffee table right in front of Reenu. He unfurls a glitter-decorated, color-coded 'Couples Adventure Itinerary' that unrolls like a cartoon scroll onto the floor. Sachin flashes a wide, toothy, hyper-optimistic Pixar grin, his expressive eyes wide with desperate romance. Reenu calmly sets her clay chaya cup down on a wooden coaster, her right eyebrow still arched playfully, peering down at the absurdly detailed schedule with a deadpan, unimpressed tilt of her head.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു, നോക്കിക്കേ! നമ്മുടെ റൊമാന്റിക് ഹണിമൂൺ ട്രിപ്പ്... മൂന്നാറിലെ മൂടൽമഞ്ഞിലേക്ക്!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium wide shot in the cozy Munnar living room. Amal swaggers in from the hallway, casually tossing his car keys into the air and catching them, his face locked in a grumpy, skeptical scowl. He has to literally step over Sachin’s glitter-decorated, color-coded 'Couples Adventure Itinerary' scroll that is still unrolled across the floor, looking down at it with utter disgust before looking up at Sachin and Reenu.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: എന്നെ വെറുതെ ഡ്രൈവർ ആക്കണ്ട കേട്ടോ. ഈ ഭ്രാന്തിനൊന്നും ഞാൻ ഇല്ല.
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up with expressive emotional focus

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium shot, vibrant living room. Reenu stands hip-cocked beside her packed duffel bag, a bright, knowing grin on her face. Instead of being offended by Amal's grumpy rejection, she chuckles warmly, stepping right over Sachin's glittery itinerary scroll. She takes a playful, wheedling step toward him, brandishing a foil-wrapped homemade beef cutlet right under his nose to bribe him, perfectly highlighting her emotionally grounded and sharp-eyed nature.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ, നീ തന്നെ വേണം നമുക്ക്. ആ തണുപ്പിൽ നിന്നൊക്കെ രക്ഷപ്പെടാൻ നിന്റെ ആ വണ്ടിയല്ലാതെ വേറെ ആരുണ്ട്?
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium tracking shot in the vibrant living room. Caught off guard by the heavenly aroma of the homemade beef cutlet, Sachin's resolve crumbles. With one hand, he takes a bite of the cutlet with wide, blissful eyes, while with the other, he frantically shoves an oversized, pristine bouquet of plastic red roses and a heart-shaped pillow into his already overflowing backpack. He glances defensively at Reenu, gesturing dramatically at the flowers to justify his ridiculous packing choices.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ഇത്... ഇത് അവിടെ ചെന്ന് റോമാന്റിക് ഫോട്ടോ എടുക്കാൻ വേണ്ടിയാ, വെറുതേയല്ല!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium tracking shot inside the cramped, misty interior of Amal's sputtering hatchback. The windows are fogged up with condensation. In the rearview mirror, Sachin is awkwardly squished in the back seat, desperately trying to keep his oversized plastic rose bouquet from blocking Reenu's view. In the front passenger seat, Amal leans over the glowing smartphone GPS, squinting through thick glasses at a bizarrely twisting digital route that seems to defy logic. Amal's face is illuminated by the eerie blue glow of the screen, looking thoroughly unnerved.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ഇത് എങ്ങോട്ടാ മാപ്പ് വെച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത്? ടവർ ലൊക്കേഷൻ മൊത്തം കാടിന്റെ നടുവിലാണല്ലോ കാണിക്കുന്നത്!
shots.camera_hint: Interior car medium shot, dynamic angle

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium closeup in the cramped backseat. Sachin flinches slightly at Amal's panicked question from the previous shot, then immediately overcompensates by leaning dramatically over the front headrests. He squeezes his face between Amal and Reenu, offering a wide, nervous grin as he waves his plastic-wrapped rose to dismiss the GPS. A droplet of condensation falls from the roof onto his nose, but he refuses to break character, gesturing grandly toward the pitch-black, fog-choked windshield outside.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ഗുഗിൾ മാപ്പിനൊക്കെ എന്ത് അറിയാം? എനിക്ക് വഴി കൃത്യമായി അറിയാം, നിങ്ങൾ വെറുതെ പേടിക്കാതിരിക്ക്!
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up with expressive emotional focus

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Tight close-up on Amal in the driver's seat, illuminated entirely by the harsh blue glow of his smartphone screen. The GPS map on the phone stutters, glroches, and flashes a stark red 'NO SIGNAL' banner. Amal’s eyes widen behind his glasses in pure terror. He sharply swivels his head back, slapping Sachin's plastic-wrapped rose away from his face with a frantic, trembling hand, nearly dropping the steering wheel.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ, നമ്മൾ വഴി തെറ്റി! ഫോണിൽ റേഞ്ചും പോയി!
shots.camera_hint: Interior car medium shot, dynamic angle

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium shot inside the car. The sudden, frantic slap of Amal's hand in the previous shot causes the car to swerve slightly, prompting Reenu to instantly grab the dashboard to steady herself. Bathed in the harsh blue glow of the dead phone and the creeping grey mist outside, Reenu's calm demeanor immediately cuts through Amal's hyperventilating panic. Pixar lighting accentuates her sharp, observant eyes as she looks from Amal to the window. Outside, the dense fog swirls in unnatural, twisting silhouettes against the headlights, exuding a chilling, atmospheric dread.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ, ഒന്ന് ശ്വാസമെടുക്ക്! ഫോൺ തർക്കിച്ചിട്ട് കാര്യമില്ല... എന്നാലും പുറത്തേക്ക് നോക്കിക്കേ, ഈ മൂന്നാർ മഞ്ഞിന് എന്തോ ഒരു വല്ലാത്ത ഭയപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന ഭംഗിയുണ്ട്.
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up with expressive emotional focus

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium-Wide Shot from the backseat. The eerie blue phone-light still washes over the cabin as Reenu’s finger presses against the frosty glass, her eyes narrowing at the shifting fog. She abruptly drops her hand and points urgently ahead into the beam of the headlights. Sachin, gripping the steering wheel with white knuckles, startles and violently whips his head back toward the windshield, his eyes wide with a mix of exhaustion and rising panic as the Pixar volumetric lighting catches the cold sweat on his brow.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ... അങ്ങോട്ട് നോക്ക്, ആ വഴിവിളക്കിന്റെ വെളിച്ചത്തിൽ... ആ സ്ത്രീ ആരാണ് അവിടെ?
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up with expressive emotional focus

episodes.synopsis: Traveling through the heavy mountain fog, Sachin, Reenu, and Amal face an eerie presence when their car sputters to a halt.
episodes.cliffhanger: A freezing handprint slowly presses against the outer window glass from the dark outside.

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Close-up inside the car, bathed in the blinding white glare of the high-beams and eerie blue phone-light. Sachin slams his foot on the brake—the car lurches violently to a halt with a sharp, echoing squeal of tires against the wet asphalt. In the backseat, Amal lets out a muffled, high-pitched shriek, pulling a thick woolen blanket completely over his head and trembling like a leaf. Sachin leans hard over the center console, jaw slack, his warm breath instantly fogging up the passenger window. Outside, the volumetric headlights cut through swirling Munnar mist, illuminating only empty, desolate blacktop where the mysterious woman stood just a fraction of a second ago. Sachin blinks rapidly, his hands trembling on the steering wheel as the cold sweat on his brow catches the cold blue phone-light.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: എന്ത് പെട്ടെന്നാ ആ വഴിപോക്കാരായ സ്ത്രീ അപ്രത്യക്ഷയായത്! കണ്ണ് തെറ്റിയ ആ നിമിഷം അവർ എങ്ങോട്ടാ പോയത്?
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D medium close-up focused on Sachin looking out window

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium shot inside the claustrophobic car, drenched in cold, eerie blue phone-light and the harsh glare of headlights. Amal erupts from the backseat like an unspooled ball of yarn, completely wrapped and tangled in the thick woolen blanket. He scrambles frantically over the center console, kicking his plush, slipper-clad feet in panic, and tumbles awkwardly into the front passenger seat/steering area. His wide, cartoonish eyes dart wildly between the pitch-black rearview mirror and the thick condensation on the windshield as he death-grips the steering wheel with trembling hands.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ഇത്രയും കോടമഞ്ഞിൽ ആ വഴിപോക്കാരായ സ്ത്രീക്ക് നടന്നുപോവാൻ പറ്റില്ല സച്ചിൻ... ദൈവമേ, നമ്മളെയെങ്ങാനും പ്രേതം തട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോകുമോ?
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D medium shot focused on Amal in driver seat

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Close-up Pixar-style shot framing Amal's wide, terror-filled eyes reflecting the frantic blinking orange lights of the dashboard. Still hopelessly cocooned in the thick woolen blanket like an oversized caterpillar, he jams the key into the ignition and twists it with manic, vibrating speed. The car engine lets out a pathetic, metallic whimper, shudders violently on its suspension, and completely dies. The dashboard lights flatline into total darkness, save for the eerie blue glow of his phone on the passenger seat. Amal freezes, his jaw dropping in slow motion as a single tear rolls down his cheek.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ചെക്കാ, നമ്മുടെ വണ്ടി ഇപ്പോൾ പണി തന്നു!
shots.camera_hint: Dramatic 3D medium close-up of Amal turning ignition key with worried look

shots.speaker: Sachin

In the passenger seat, Sachin firmly clicks open his seatbelt, his face illuminated by the cold blue light of his phone screen as he turns on the flashlight. He shoots a reassuring yet tense glance at Amal, his thumb instinctively touching the strap of his cross-bag, before pushing the heavy passenger door open into the mist-choked Munnar night.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ, നീ ലൈറ്റ് ഓഫ് ചെയ്യാതെ... ഞാൻ താഴെയിറങ്ങി ബോണറ്റ് ഒന്ന് നോക്കട്ടെ.

shots.speaker: Reenu

Instantly, Reenu leans forward aggressively from the rear seat, her knuckles whitening as she grips Sachin's shoulder and the front headrest. Her eyes are wide with primal panic, Pixar-style lighting catching the cold blue reflection of the fog in her pupils as she desperately pulls him back toward the safety of the car.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ, പുറത്തിറങ്ങരുത്! നോക്ക്... ആരോ നമ്മുടെ കാറിനെ പിന്തുടരുന്നുണ്ട്!
shots.camera_hint: Expressive 3D close-up of Reenu leaning between front seats in dread
