Amal shrieks in high-pitched panic, his eyes bulging comically like a startled cartoon owl. He aggressively jams his thumb down on the central locking button, his hand shaking uncontrollably while frantically pointing at the exterior fog with wide-eyed disbelief.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അയ്യോ! ദൈവമേ! പെട്ടെന്ന് എല്ലാ വാതിലുകളും ലോക്ക് ചെയ്യ്! അത്... അത് പുറത്തുണ്ട്!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic 3D medium close-up of Amal snapping lock down

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Close-Up (CU) on Sachin inside the shadowy car interior. Illuminated by the eerie, pulsing blue glow of the dashboard dials. He tumbles completely back into the cabin, chest heaving rapidly as he gasps for air, adrenaline pumping. He shivers violently—not just from the freezing monsoon draft whistling through the cracked window, but from sheer terror. His wide, stunned eyes dart from the frosty driver-side window back to the rear where Reenu is gripping him. He clenches his cross-bag defensively against his chest with white-knuckled grip, staring in horror at the pane of glass.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: എന്റെ പൊന്നോ... ഇതെന്താ മനുഷ്യന്റെ ദേഹത്തേക്ക് ചാടി വീണത്?! ആ കണ്ണുകൾ... അത്... അതൊരു മനുഷ്യനല്ല!
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up of Sachin shivering by passenger window

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS) inside the dim, claustrophobic car cabin. Amal, sitting rigidly in the driver's seat, flinches violently as Sachin falls back against him. Illuminated by the eerie, flickering blue dashboard light, Amal's eyes bulge with sheer superstitious dread. He throws his hands up defensively over the steering wheel, his head snapping toward the frost-fogged side rearview mirror where a looming, unnatural shadow presses against the glass.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: എന്റെ അമ്മോ! കണ്ണാടിയിൽ നോക്കിക്കേ, ആ രൂപം... അത് നമ്മളെത്തന്നെയാ നോക്കുന്നത്!
shots.camera_hint: Over-the-shoulder 3D shot past Amal looking into mirror reflection

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Close-Up (CU) on Sachin. Shivering from the freezing Munnar air and the shock of the looming shadow, Sachin frantically scrambles the rest of his body inside, his boots scraping the car frame. With a panicked grunt, he violently heaves the heavy passenger door shut, the metal sealing with a loud, echoing thud. He slams the manual door knob down, twists around to face Amal, and grabs Amal's jacket lapel, shaking him out of his superstitious paralysis. Pixar-style lighting highlights Sachin's wide, terror-filled eyes reflecting the flickering dashboard blues.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ഡോർ ലോക്ക് ആയില്ലേ അമൽ, വേഗം... വേഗം വണ്ടി സ്റ്റാർട്ട് ചെയ്യ്!
shots.camera_hint: Tense two-shot of Sachin turning frantically to Amal in driver seat

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS) framed from the front passenger side looking into the back seat. As Amal fumbles frantically with the ignition key, the engine sputtering and refusing to catch, Reenu's eyes go wide with absolute terror. She recoils against the opposite door, her breath hitching as a pale, glowing, translucent handprint slowly presses itself onto the freezing condensation of the outer window glass from the pitch-black exterior. Pixar-style volumetric moonlight cuts through the mist, illuminating the horrifying details of the handprint while casting deep, expressive shadows across Reenu's petrified face.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ആ കൈപ്പാട്... നോക്ക്, അത് ജനാലയിലാണ്! വണ്ടി സ്റ്റാർട്ട് ചെയ്യ് അമൽ, പെട്ടെന്ന്!
shots.camera_hint: Chilling 3D close-up of Reenu's terrified face with glowing handprint on glass

episodes.synopsis: Handing keys, looking suspicious. Footsteps heard outside.
episodes.cliffhanger: The door creaks open. Dialogue: 'അർദ്ധരാത്രിയിൽ ആ മുറി തുറന്നു.'

shots.speaker: Caretaker
shots.action: Wide Shot (WS) transitioning smoothly to a Medium Shot (MS) inside the dimly lit, creaking colonial homestay hallway. The heavy wooden front door bursts open with a loud groan, and Sachin violently kicks it shut behind them, throwing the deadbolt with a metallic clack. Sachin pants heavily, his shoulders heaving as he shields a terrified, shivering Reenu. Beside them, Amal is hyperventilating, clutching his chest with wide, panicked eyes. The flickering, amber glow of a wall sconce cuts through the misty chill clinging to their coats. Stepping out from the shadows with an unsettling, statue-like stillness, Caretaker Sreedharan observes their absolute terror without a hint of surprise. With slow, mechanical movements, Sreedharan reaches into the pocket of his frayed cardigan, pulls out a heavy, jangling iron ring of skeleton keys, and extends it toward Sachin. Sreedharan's eyes dart sideways toward the pitch-black corridor behind him, his expression tightening into a grim, chilling mask.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: കെയർടേക്കർ: (തണുത്ത സ്വരത്തിൽ) 'താക്കോലുകൾ ഇതാ... പക്ഷേ ഓർക്കുക, ആ ഇടനാഴിയുടെ അറ്റത്തുള്ള പതിമൂന്നാം നമ്പർ മുറി... ഒരിക്കലും ആരും തുറക്കരുത്.'
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up with expressive emotional focus

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium Close-Up (MCU). The warm, flickering glow of the wall sconce catches the cold sweat dripping down Sachin's forehead. He is still heaving for breath, clutching the heavy iron keys so tightly his knuckles are white. Behind him, Reenu is frantically wiping mist off the frosted windowpane to peer into the dark courtyard, while Amal is huddled under a woolen shawl, shivering and muttering prayers. Sachin looks down at the heavy brass padlock of Room 13 right beside him, his panic slowly giving way to a stubborn, bewildered curiosity as he stares at the forbidden door.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (കിതപ്പ് അടക്കിക്കൊണ്ട്) 'പുറത്ത് ആ ഇരുട്ടിൽ എന്തോ ഒന്നുണ്ടായിരുന്നു... എന്നിട്ടും ഇയാൾ ഈ മുറി പൂട്ടി സൂക്ഷിക്കാൻ പറയുന്നു! ഇതിനുള്ളിൽ എന്താ ഇത്ര വലിയ രഹസ്യം?'
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up with expressive emotional focus

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), slightly low angle to emphasize the intimidating, towering dark wood of Room 13's door. Amal is still huddled tightly inside his thick woolen shawl like a frightened turtle, his teeth chattering audibly. Hearing Sachin's whispered curiosity, Amal's eyes widen in a panic. He frantically waves his flashlight in a wild arc, casting erratic shadows across the peeling vintage wallpaper, desperately trying to laugh away his own mounting dread as he leans against the wooden balustrade.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, തമാശയിലൂടെ ഭയം മറക്കാൻ ശ്രമിക്കുന്നു) 'അയ്യോ, അതോ! ഒരുപക്ഷേ ആ പഴയ ബ്രിട്ടീഷ് സായിപ്പിന്റെ കട്ടപ്പാരയും സ്വർണവും ഒളിപ്പിച്ചുവെച്ച രഹസ്യ റൂം ആയിരിക്കും ഇത്!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Close-Up (MCU), warm volumetric moonlight mixed with the erratic, jittery yellow beam of Amal's flashlight slicing across the peeling floral wallpaper. Reenu steps smoothly into the frame, ignoring Amal's cowardly joke. She crosses her arms defensively against the Munnar chill, her sharp eyes tracking Caretaker Sreedharan's hunched silhouette disappearing down the staircase at the far end of the hall. She glances back at Amal, who is still cowering inside his woolen shawl like a startled turtle, his teeth chattering. Reenu rolls her eyes at his theatrics, lowering her voice to a tense, analytical whisper.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: 'നീ വെറുതെ ആ ടോർച്ച് അടിച്ച് ഭയപ്പെടാതെ അമൽ... ആ കെയർടേക്കറുടെ കണ്ണുകളിൽ ഒരു വല്ലാത്ത പേടിയുണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അയാൾ നമ്മളിൽ നിന്ന് എന്തോ വലിയ കാര്യം മറയ്ക്കുന്നുണ്ട്.'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), warm, amber-lit Pixar bedroom with rustic wooden paneling. The room is half-lit by a bedside lamp casting long, distorted shadows. Sachin is mid-motion, unpacking his travel bag over the wooden bed when the heavy, rhythmic creaking of floorboards echoes sharply outside. Suddenly, the door flies open—Reenu slips inside from the hallway, quickly clicking the heavy brass latch shut behind her with a breathless, urgent gesture. Sachin freezes, dropping his bag onto the mattress with a soft thud, his eyes locking onto Reenu's tense, analytical expression as she catches her breath.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: 'കേട്ടോ? ആ ഇടനാഴിയിൽ ആരോ നടക്കുന്നുണ്ട്... ഈ പാതിരാത്രിയിൽ ആരാണ്?'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Close-Up (MCU), dynamic Pixar camera framing. The warm amber lighting from the bedside lamp flickers as the shadow outside the door stretches longer. Amal—eyes wide with absolute, cartoonish terror—dives headfirst under the floral bedsheet on the rustic wooden bed, his foot momentarily tangling in the hem. He frantically reaches out, grabbing Sachin’s elbow with a death grip to yank him back from the door. Meanwhile, Reenu stands right beside Sachin, her expression sharp and watchful, clutching a heavy brass candlestick as a makeshift weapon.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: 'സച്ചിൻ, വെറുതെ സാഹസം കാണിക്കാതെ വാതിൽ അടച്ചു കിടക്കാൻ നോക്ക്!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D style. The warm amber lamplight flickers as long, creeping shadows dance across the wooden floorboards. Sachin stumbles backward slightly from Amal's sudden death-grip yank, his eyes wide with a mix of lingering fear and stubborn curiosity. Behind him, Reenu stays locked in her defensive stance, her knuckles white around the heavy brass candlestick, whispering a sharp warning while keeping her eyes fixed on the door. Breaking free from Amal's frantic tug, Sachin exhales a shaky breath, squares his shoulders, and slowly tiptoes toward the door, his hand cautiously reaching out to wrap around the cold brass knob.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: 'അയ്യോ, വിട് അമൽ... പേടിക്കാതെടാ, ഞാൻ പതുക്കെ വാതിൽ തുറന്ന് ഒന്ന് നോക്കട്ടെ.'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Close-Up (CU) transitioning to Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D style. The heavy wooden door creaks open with a spine-chilling sound, revealing the dark, mist-choked hallway bathed in an eerie, pale blue moonlight spilling from the tall colonial window. Sachin peeks out cautiously, but before he can take a full step, Amal—who has been clutching the fabric of Sachin's yellow hoodie with both fists like a frightened koala—peeks out right past Sachin's shoulder, his eyes squeezed half-shut, trembling violently as the cold Munnar draft hits them.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: 'എന്നെ ഇവിടെ തനിച്ചാക്കി പോകണ്ടടാ... ദൈവമേ, ആ ഇരുട്ടത്തേക്ക് നോക്കണ്ട, എനിക്ക് പേടിയാകുന്നു!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D style. Reacting to a sudden, elongated shadow gliding silently across the far colonial wall, Sachin's eyes widen. Stumbling slightly under Amal's frantic, koala-like grip, Sachin uses his weight to pivot them both sharply. He grabs a handful of the heavy, dust-laden velvet window curtain, yanking Amal along with him as they scramble to squeeze behind the thick crimson folds, holding their breath as a chilling gust of Munnar wind billows the fabric around them.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: 'ശബ്ദമുണ്ടാക്കരുത്... അനങ്ങാതെ നിൽക്ക്, ആ കർട്ടന്റെ പിന്നിലേക്ക്!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Narrator
shots.action: Close-Up (CU) peering through a narrow gap in the heavy crimson velvet curtain, Pixar 3D style. Sachin and Amal are crammed together, their eyes wide with sheer terror, lit by an eerie, pale moonlight reflecting off the polished wooden floor. Amal's hands are clamped tightly over his own mouth to muffle his heavy breathing, while Sachin cautiously parts the fabric an inch further. Through the gap, they watch in absolute horror as the massive, rusted padlock on the door of Room 13 rattles violently, clicks open by itself, and the heavy wooden door slowly creaks inward, revealing a suffocating, pitch-black void within.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: നരേറ്റർ: 'പാതിരാത്രിയുടെ നിശബ്ദതയിൽ, ആ പതിമൂന്നാം നമ്പർ മുറി തനിയെ തുറക്കപ്പെട്ടു!'
shots.camera_hint: Slow eerie zoom on the decaying door of Room 13 opening into shadow

episodes.synopsis: Picking up the photo. The lights flicker.
episodes.cliffhanger: Staring at the changed photo. Dialogue: 'അവിടെ മൂന്നുപേർ!'

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Wide Shot (WS), Pixar 3D style, bridging the previous episode's terrifying climax. The heavy wooden door of Room 13 swings fully open with a loud, echoing groan. Out steps Reenu, calm and composed, holding her trembling smartphone flashlight high to cut through the thick, dust-laden air. In the foreground, Sachin and Amal—who were just pressed against the crimson curtain—trip over each other in a frantic, limbs-tangled heap on the polished floor, gasping for air. Sachin scrambles backward on his elbows, wide-eyed, while Amal hides behind Sachin's leg, whimpering. Reenu lowers her phone slightly, looking down at the squirming duo with an utterly unimpressed, arched-eyebrow expression. She gestures casually with her thumb toward the dimly lit interior behind her, where an eerie antique framed black-and-white photograph sits on a dust-covered wooden dresser.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: 'നിങ്ങൾ എന്തിനാ അവിടെ പതുങ്ങിയിരുന്നത്? സച്ചിൻ, എഴുന്നേറ്റ് ഇങ്ങോട്ട് വന്നു നോക്കൂ... ഈ ഫോട്ടോയിലുള്ള സ്ത്രീ നമ്മൾ ഹൈവേയിൽ ലിഫ്റ്റ് ചോദിച്ച അതേ ആളല്ലേ?!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D style. Sachin is still on his knees, frantically brushing dust off his jacket and gasping for breath while casting nervous glances back at the dark hallway. Amal cowers behind him, clutching Sachin's shoulder with wide, terrified eyes. Stepping past them into the dim, misty light of Room 13, Sachin shakily takes the dusty antique frame from Reenu. He holds it close to his smartphone light, his eyes darting across the silver border and the vintage black-and-white portrait inside, desperately trying to mask his own racing heartbeat with forced logic.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: '(ശ്വാസം കിട്ടാതെ) ഹുഫ്... എന്റെ അമ്മോ, എന്റെ ഹൃദയം നിന്നു പോയേനെ! (ഫോട്ടോ വാങ്ങി നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ട്) ഇത്... ഇത് ആ പഴയ എസ്റ്റേറ്റ് ഉടമയുടെ കുടുംബചിത്രം ആയിരിക്കാം... വെറുമൊരു യാദാർത്ഥ്യം, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ സാമ്യം മാത്രമാകും റീനു.'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D style. Amal is still trembling uncontrollably, his back pressed against the doorframe of Room 13 as he frantically looks back and forth between the pitch-black hallway outside and Sachin, who is holding the creepy photo. Amal's teeth chatter loudly in the biting mountain breeze, his knuckles white as he grips his travel bag. He reaches out with a shaking hand to grab Sachin's elbow, trying to physically pull him toward the exit.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: '(വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, ഇരുണ്ട ഇടനാഴിയിലേക്ക് നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ട്) മതിയാക്ക് സച്ചിൻ! ആ ഫോട്ടോയും വെച്ച് അവിടെത്തന്നെ നിന്നോ, ഞാൻ പറയുന്നില്ല... വേഗം ആ വാതിലടച്ച് നമ്മുടെ മുറിയിലേക്ക് പോകാം! ഇവിടെ എന്തോ ശരിയല്ല!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Narrator
shots.action: Close-Up (CU) moving to Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D style. Just as Amal’s trembling fingers latch onto Sachin’s elbow, a ferocious, unnatural gale-force wind howls up from the valley floor. With a deafening *BANG*, the heavy teak door slams shut with bone-rattling force, automatically throwing the heavy brass deadbolt into place with a sharp, echoing *CLACK*. Dust and ancient cobwebs explode from the frame, illuminated briefly by the flickering hallway sconces before they plunge into pitch darkness. Amal lets out a high-pitched, cartoonish shriek, dropping his travel bag as he flails blindly in the dark, bumping directly into Sachin's back.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: നരേറ്റർ: 'അമലിന്റെ കൈകൾ സച്ചിന്റെ ദേഹത്ത് എത്തും മുൻപ്, പെട്ടെന്ന് ഒരു കൊടുംകാറ്റ് ആഞ്ഞുവീശി ഭാരമുള്ള ആ തേക്കുവാതിൽ അലർച്ചയോടെ കൊട്ടിയടയ്ക്കപ്പെട്ടു! ഒപ്പം കുറ്റി സ്വയം വീണു!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS) to Close-Up (CU), Pixar 3D style. Total darkness envelopes the screen, pierced only by Amal's frantic, high-pitched hyperventilating and the sound of his fingers clawing desperately at Sachin's jacket like a drowning koala. Suddenly, the single overhead tungsten filament bulb stutters to life with a loud, angry *BUZZ*, casting grotesque, jittery shadows against peeling Victorian wallpaper. Sachin’s eyes widen in sheer terror beneath his glasses, his jaw clenched as he tries to maintain a brave front. With one final, pathetic *POP*, the bulb blows out completely, plunging them back into absolute blackness. Sachin fumbles frantically in his pocket, his hand shaking as he drags out his smartphone.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: 'ലൈറ്റ് പോയി! ആരും... ആരും പരിഭ്രാന്തരാവരുത്, എന്റെ ഫോൺ ടോർച്ച്... ഒന്ന് നിക്കടേ, ഇത് എവിടെയാ ഓൺ ആവുന്നത്?!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Voice
shots.action: Close-Up (CU) on Sachin's trembling hands as the smartphone screen finally stutters to life, casting an eerie, pale blue cinematic glow across his glasses and terrified face. Tucked tightly against his side, Amal is whimpering with his eyes clamped shut, his knuckles white as he grips Sachin's jacket. The sudden blue light reveals dust motes dancing in the freezing air—and right beside them, the peeling wallpaper begins to warp. In the absolute quiet, an ethereal, mournful female whisper brushes directly against Sachin's ear, making the hairs on his arm stand on end.
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up with expressive emotional focus

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: The sudden, ethereal whisper triggers an instant explosion of pure, unadulterated panic. Amal lets out a high-pitched, comical shriek of pure terror and violently launches himself onto Sachin like an over-excited koala, wrapping his arms and legs around Sachin's neck and torso. The sudden impact knocks Sachin off balance, sending the smartphone clattering onto the ancient wooden floorboards. The phone's screen faces upward, casting a dramatic, jittery blue horror-movie up-light across their wide, saucer-like eyes and distorted features against the dark, freezing backdrop of Room 13.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: 'അയ്യോ! ആ ശബ്ദം കേട്ടോ?! സച്ചിൻ, എന്നെ ഇവിടെ നിന്നും രക്ഷിക്കണേ! ഭൂതം പിടിച്ചു!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Close-Up to Medium Shot (CU to MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Sachin staggers backward under Amal's crushing, koala-like weight, his eyes wide with a mix of suffocation and absolute terror. He frantically sweeps his hand along the damp, ice-cold timber wall, his fingers desperately grazing old wooden paneling searching for a switchboard. At his feet, the dropped smartphone's screen casts an eerie, flickering blue glow upward, illuminating their distorted, panicked faces while the ethereal whisper echoes faintly in the shadows.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: 'അമൽ, എന്റെ കഴുത്തിൽ നിന്ന് കൈയെടുക്ക്! എനിക്ക് ശ്വാസം മുട്ടുന്നു... ആ ഫോൺ താഴെ വീണു, എവിടെയാ സ്വിച്ച്?!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS) transitioning to Medium Close-Up (MCU), Pixar 3D Camera: Sachin's palm finally smacks hard against an archaic, heavy brass toggle switch on the damp timber wall. *SNAP.* A single, naked yellow bulb overhead sputters once, then hums to life, casting a harsh, jaundiced glare over the cramped, fog-chilled room. Sachin violently pries Amal's white-knuckled death grip from his neck, stumbling forward into the middle of the room, gasping for oxygen. Chest heaving, sweat glistening on his forehead, he turns to see Reenu. She is frozen stiff against the corner of the antique dresser, her face drained of color, shaking finger extended rigidly toward a tarnished silver-framed photograph resting among the dust.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: '(വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, തൊണ്ടയിടറി) സച്ചിൻ... അമൽ... ആ ഫോട്ടോയിലേക്ക് ഒന്നു കൂടി നോക്കൂ! നമ്മൾ... നമ്മൾ പെട്ടു!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS) shifting to Close-Up (CU), Pixar 3D Camera: Sachin stumbles backward, his boots sliding on the dust-caked floorboards. Driven by Reenu's paralyzed panic, he and a whimpering Amal scramble across the cramped room, huddling tightly around her. Sachin's trembling hands reach out to slowly lift the tarnished silver-framed photograph from the dresser. The harsh jaundiced light from the overhead bulb cuts across the glass. In tight CU, their wide, horror-struck eyes reflect the image: where a solitary, ghostly woman stood in faded monochrome just moments ago, three distinct, living human silhouettes are now unmistakably pressed into the background of the frame.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: '(വിറയ്ക്കുന്ന ചുണ്ടോടെ, തേങ്ങിക്കൊണ്ട്) എന്റെ കർത്താവേ... അവിടെ ഇപ്പോൾ മൂന്നുപേരുണ്ട്! നമ്മൾ... നമ്മൾ ആ ഫോട്ടോയിൽ കയറിപ്പറ്റിയോ?!'
shots.camera_hint: Dramatic extreme close-up pushing in on the altered photograph

episodes.synopsis: Taking photos of Renu. Entering the old building.
episodes.cliffhanger: Calling Renu. Dialogue: 'റീനു...'

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Wide Establishing Shot (WS) shifting to Medium Close-Up (MCU), Pixar 3D Camera: The dense, freezing Munnar morning fog blankets the sprawling tea estate. Sachin, Reenu, and Amal burst out from the heavy wooden doors of the estate bungalow, gasping for breath, their eyes wide with lingering adrenaline-fueled terror. Reenu's hands shake violently as she clutches her digital camera to her chest like a shield, while Sachin frantically pats his jacket pocket where the cold, cursed silver-framed photograph rests. The golden dawn light struggles to pierce the mist, casting an eerie, supernatural chill over the lush green landscape.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: '(ശ്വാസം കിട്ടാതെ, വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്) റീനു... നമ്മൾ... നമ്മൾ ആ റൂമിൽ നിന്ന് പുറത്തിറങ്ങി! ഇനി... ഇനി നമ്മൾ ആ ഫോട്ടോയിലേക്ക നോക്കാനേ പാടില്ല!'
shots.camera_hint: Warm golden morning sunlight, slow panning medium two-shot tracking Sachin and Reenu

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Amal stumbles backward through the wet tea bushes right behind Sachin and Reenu, his oversized hoodie half-zipped and eyes bloodshot from a sleepless night of pure terror. He clutches his phone in one hand while using the other to frantically rub his face, staring incredulously at Sachin's frantic warning. The cold Munnar dew clings to his fuzzy hair as he stammers out his complaint, looking nervously back toward the shadowy bungalow behind them.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: '(വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, ഉറക്കം തൂങ്ങി) രാത്രി മുഴുവൻ ആ പ്രേതാലയത്തിൽ ഇരുന്ന് പേടിച്ച് വിറച്ചിട്ട്... ഇപ്പോൾ നേരം വെളുത്തപ്പോൾ ഒരു ഫോട്ടോഷൂട്ട് നടത്താൻ ഇറങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു! എനിക്ക് ഉറങ്ങണംഡേയ്!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Close-Up (MCU), Pixar 3D Camera: Reenu flinches as Amal stumbles backward into the bushes right beside her. She quickly regains her composure, shooting an exasperated yet empathetic look at Amal's sleep-deprived state. As Amal continues to mutter complaints about wanting to sleep, Reenu looks past him, her sharp eyes catching something intriguing through a gap in the mist-shrouded tea plants. She steps around Amal, parting the dew-laden leaves to reveal a moss-covered, ancient stone footpath disappearing into the dense, brooding jungle bordering the estate.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: 'അമൽ, ഒന്നു മിണ്ടാതിരിക്കൂ... സച്ചിൻ, അങ്ങോട്ട് നോക്കൂ. തോട്ടത്തിന്റെ അപ്പുറത്തേക്ക് പഴയൊരു കൽപ്പാത പോകുന്നുണ്ട്.'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Amal instantly recoils backward, tripping over his own slippers as he stares down the eerie, fog-choked stone path. His eyes bulge with cartoonish terror, arms flailing wildly as he clutches an imaginary shield of personal safety. He shakes his head emphatically, backing away toward the safety of the estate bungalow, desperate to be anywhere near the warm breakfast table.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: 'നമുക്ക് അങ്ങോട്ട് പോകേണ്ട ഒരു ആവശ്യവുമില്ല! ആ മൂടൽമഞ്ഞും കാട്ടുവഴികളും കണ്ടില്ലേ? എനിക്ക് നല്ല പന്തികേട് തോന്നുന്നു, നമുക്ക് തിരിച്ചു നടക്കാം!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Wide Shot (WS), Pixar 3D Camera: The scene picks up the very next second from Amal's retreat. Sachin and Reenu are mid-struggle, physically dragging a loudly protesting, heel-dragging Amal across the misty lawn toward the frame. Amal's slippers go flying off into the wet grass as he kicks and thrashes, clutching at bushes for dear life. Sachin grunts with exertion, firmly gripping Amal by his jacket collar while Reenu pushes Amal's back with a determined grin, finally hauling the reluctant coward right up to the creaking, rusted iron gates of the colonial tea factory. A thick blanket of curling white fog swirls around their ankles. Sachin lets go, casually dusting off his hands and adjusting his glasses with an optimistic smile, while Reenu peers cautiously through the rusted bars into the gloomy courtyard. Amal instantly cowers behind Sachin, clutching his head in pure regret and whimpering.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: 'കണ്ടില്ലേ അമൽ, ഒടുവിൽ നമ്മൾ എത്തി! ഇനി അവിടെ നിന്ന് കരഞ്ഞിട്ട് കാര്യമില്ല, ഇവിടെ എന്തൊക്കെയോ രഹസ്യങ്ങൾ ഒളിഞ്ഞിരിപ്പുണ്ട്.'
shots.location: Plantation Path leading to Abandoned tea factory exterior
shots.camera_hint: Atmospheric wide low-angle shot showing dilapidated factory looms through mountain mist

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Panning swiftly from the creaking iron gates, Reenu steps decisively past a trembling Amal—who is still whimpering and clutching Sachin's sleeve—and pushes open a rotting wooden office door inside the decaying factory. Shafts of ethereal moonlight cut through the thick dust motes swirling in the abandoned room. Reenu walks straight to a rotting mahogany desk, brushes a thick layer of dust off a decaying leather-bound estate ledger, and gasps as she reads a haunting entry from 1994, her eyes widening in the dim light.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: 'അമൽ, ആ കൈവിറയൽ ഒന്ന് നിർത്തി ഇങ്ങോട്ട് നോക്ക്! ഇവിടെ നോക്കൂ... ഭദ്ര എന്നൊരു സ്ത്രീയെക്കുറിച്ച് ഈ പഴയ ഡയറിയിൽ എന്തൊക്കെയോ എഴുതിയിട്ടുണ്ട്!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Close-Up (MCU), Pixar 3D Camera: Pushing in tight on Amal's wide, panicked eyes illuminated by the cold moonlight. He violently shoves a rusty iron pipe forward like a clumsy spear, swinging wildly at shadows in the dusty rafters where frightened pigeons burst upward with a loud flutter of wings. Sachin immediately steps in front of Reenu, one hand raised to steady Amal's shaking pipe while keeping his eyes locked on the dark doorway, maintaining the protective, grounded anchor of the group.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: 'ഡയറി അവിടെ വെച്ചിട്ട് നമുക്ക് തിരിച്ചു പോകാം റീനു, എനിക്ക് ഇവിടുത്തെ പൊരുത്തം ഒട്ടും പിടിക്കുന്നില്ല!'
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up with expressive emotional focus

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Sachin firmly grips the end of Amal's shaking iron pipe, slowly and deliberately pushing it down while keeping his eyes darting toward the dark, echoing doorway. As the sudden flutter of pigeons fades into eerie silence, Sachin uses his free hand to slide open a heavy, dust-covered ledger on the rotting mahogany desk. He pulls out a moisture-curled charcoal sketch, holding it up into the pale beam of his flashlight so Reenu and a trembling Amal can see it. Reenu leans in closely, her breath fogging in the cold air.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: 'അമൽ, ആ കമ്പി താഴ്ത്തു... ശബ്ദമുണ്ടാക്കാതെ. ഇത് നോക്കൂ, ഇത് അവൾ തന്നെയാണ്... റോഡിൽ നമ്മൾ കണ്ട അതേ സ്ത്രീയുടെ ചിത്രം.'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Close-Up (MCU), Pixar 3D Camera: The harsh beam of Sachin's flashlight illuminates the charcoal sketch, casting eerie, distorted shadows across Amal's wide, terror-stricken eyes. Amal stumbles backward, his jaw dropping as he recognizes the face from the road, his hands trembling violently as he fends off the air. He instinctively retreats into the deep, inky shadows cast by the towering, rusted iron tea-drying machinery, his boots crunching loudly on broken glass and dried tea leaves. Reenu keeps her eyes locked on the drawing, grabbing Sachin's sleeve.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: 'എന്റെ കർത്താവേ... അത്... അത് അന്ന് റോഡിൽ നിന്ന ആ പെൺകുട്ടി തന്നെയാ! ഇനി ഈ പഴയ കാര്യങ്ങൾ അറിഞ്ഞിട്ട് നമ്മൾ എന്ത് ചെയ്യാനാണ് സച്ചിൻ, നമുക്ക് ഇവിടെിന്നും രക്ഷപ്പെടാം!'
shots.location: Abandoned tea factory - Interior Office to Machinery Floor Threshold
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Voice
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Sachin's flashlight swings wildly from Amal disappearing into the shadows to lock onto Reenu's face, her eyes wide with sudden realization. Before either can speak, a freezing gust of wind sweeps through the broken roof, instantly extinguishing Sachin's flashlight with a sharp hiss. In the sudden pitch-black darkness, illuminated only by the faint, eerie blue glow of the phone screen, an ethereal, sorrowful whisper drifts down from the towering iron rafters, directly calling Reenu's name. Reenu freezes, goosebumps rising on her arms, while Sachin instinctively shoves her slightly behind him, his flashlight flickering back to life with a desperate slap against his palm.
shots.location: Abandoned tea factory - Interior Machinery Floor
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic high-angle shot looking down from dark factory rafters onto trio

episodes.synopsis: Setting up his phone. They run out.
episodes.cliffhanger: Finding the note. Dialogue: 'പഴയ പാലത്തിൽ പോകരുത്...'

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Wide Shot (WS) transitioning to Close-Up (CU), Pixar 3D Camera: The terrifying female whisper from the high factory rafters still echoes in the freezing air. Sachin and Reenu cling to each other, Sachin's flashlight beam trembling wildly across the rusted machinery. Suddenly, the beam illuminates Amal huddled near a massive gear shaft. Terrified out of his wits, Amal is frantically waving his smartphone duct-taped to a tree branch like an improvised ghost-detector, trying to mask his overwhelming dread with hysterical comedic bluster.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, ഫോൺ ഉയർത്തിക്കാട്ടി) 'അയ്യോ, പേടിക്കണ്ട... നോക്കിക്കേ, ഇതാണ് എന്റെ ആത്മ-സംവേദന ഉപകരണം! കിടിലൻ ഐഡിയ അല്ലേ?'
shots.location: Abandoned tea factory - Interior Machinery Floor
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Close-Up (CU) on Sachin, Pixar 3D Camera: Sachin's face contorts from sheer terror into absolute exasperation. He drops his shaking flashlight beam directly onto Amal's ridiculous makeshift tripod setup, his mouth hanging open in disbelief. Reenu peeks out from behind Sachin's shoulder, her eyes widening at Amal before crossing her arms in a mix of relief and pure annoyance. Volumetric moonlight cuts through the dusty haze, highlighting floating dust motes around Sachin's ruffled hair and wide, panicked eyes.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (ദേഷ്യവും ഭയവും കലർന്ന്) 'അതൊരു ശബ്ദമായിരുന്നു! നീ ഇവിടെ വന്ന് റീൽസ് ഉണ്ടാക്കുകയാണോ കുന്തേ?! ഞങ്ങളിവിടെ പേടിച്ചു ചാവുന്നു!'
shots.location: Abandoned tea factory - Interior Machinery Floor
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Reenu steps firmly past a still-fuming Sachin, her annoyance at Amal instantly evaporating as the beam of her flashlight catches a cluster of strange, glowing tribal markings etched deep into the rusted iron plating of the factory wall. She steps closer, narrowing her eyes in intense concentration. Sachin stammers in the background, still catching his breath, while Amal nervously adjusts his phone camera off-screen.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: (ഗൗരവത്തോടെ, ടോർച്ച് അടിച്ചു കാണിച്ച്) 'അമലിന്റെ കളി നിർത്തിയിട്ട് ഇങ്ങോട്ട് നോക്ക്. ഇത് എന്താ ഇവിടെ ഈ ഭിത്തിയിൽ?'
shots.location: Abandoned tea factory - Interior Machinery Floor
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Close-Up (MCU), Pixar 3D Camera: Amal nervously shuffles into the frame beside Reenu, his knees visibly shaking as his phone's camera light illuminates the glowing tribal markings. Instead of looking at the eerie etchings, he keeps his eyes glued to the dark factory shadows, forcing a weak, nervous grin to hide his panic while gesturing dismissively at the wall.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്) അത് പിന്നെ... ഇവിടെയുള്ള പ്രേതങ്ങൾക്കും നമ്മുടെ ഹോംസ്റ്റേ ബില്ല് ഷെയർ ചെയ്യാൻ താല്പര്യം ഉണ്ടാവും!
shots.location: Abandoned tea factory - Interior Machinery Floor
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Wide Shot (WS), Pixar 3D Camera: The moment Amal finishes his joke, the eerie tribal markings on the rusty machinery violently pulse with an unearthly, blinding blue light, accompanied by a low, mechanical grinding roar from deep beneath the factory floor. Sachin's eyes go wide with sudden alarm; he drops his flashlight, grabs Reenu's hand, and forcefully yanks Amal backward by his backpack. Sachin turns to the camera, his face a mix of raw terror and protective urgency, shouting 'Run!' as all three scramble in a chaotic, limbs-flying stampede toward the broken exit doors.
shots.location: Abandoned tea factory - Interior Machinery Floor
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Bursting head-first through the rusted, swinging doors of the abandoned tea factory, Sachin, Reenu, and Amal tumble out onto the overgrown gravel clearing outside, gasping for air. Amal crashes onto all fours, his chest heaving wildly, eyes wide with residual panic. Mid-gasp, his gaze drops to the damp mud right beside his hand. He freezes, pointing a trembling finger at a fresh, distinct set of massive bare footprints leading straight into the dark mist. Sachin stumbles up behind him, leaning on his knees, panting heavily as he glares down at Amal.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (കിതച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, വിറയ്ക്കുന്ന കൈ ചൂണ്ടി) ഹേയ്... നോക്ക്... ഇതാര് വന്നതാ ഇവിടെ?
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Low-angle close-up on Reenu, her face illuminated by the flickering, cold blue glow of her smartphone flashlight. She drops to her knees beside Amal and Sachin, staring in stunned disbelief at the massive bare footprints fresh in the mud. She pulls her jacket tighter against the freezing Munnar night air, her breath pluming in white puffs as she looks up from the tracks toward the looming, fog-choked tea factory doors. She shakes her head, her voice sharp and resolute through chattering teeth.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: (വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, കാൽപ്പാടുകളിൽ നിന്നും ഫാക്ടറിയിലേക്ക് നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ട്) ഇന്ന് രാത്രി ഇവിടെ നിൽക്കാൻ പറ്റില്ല... നമുക്ക് എങ്ങനെയെങ്കിലും ഈ ഹോംസ്റ്റേയിൽ തിരിച്ചെത്തിയേ പറ്റൂ!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Inside the warm, dimly lit homestay living room. The heavy wooden door bursts open, and Sachin, Reenu, and Amal stumble inside, panting heavily, chests heaving with white plumes of breath in the cold air. Amal immediately slams the door shut, throwing the heavy deadbolt and sliding a rustic wooden security bar into place with trembling hands. He leans his back against the door, sliding down halfway to the floor in sheer exhaustion and terror, clutching his chest. Sachin and Reenu rush in behind him, frantically scanning the shuttered windows as the wind howls outside.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (കിതച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, വാതിലിൽ ചാരിയിരുന്ന്) ദൈവമേ... നമ്മൾ രക്ഷപ്പെട്ടു! ഇനി... ഇനി ആരും പുറത്തുപോകില്ല, പുറത്തുനിന്നും ആരും അകത്തോട്ടു വരില്ല!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Close-Up (CU), Pixar 3D Camera: Tight on Sachin. His face is illuminated only by the faint, eerie blue moonlight filtering through the dusty wooden window slats. Beads of cold sweat glisten on his forehead. He is kneeling beside the trembling Amal, breathing heavily, his chest rising and falling rapidly. Sachin's eyes dart toward the rattling window panes as a chilling gust of wind howls outside, violently shaking the glass. Reenu stands right behind him, tightly gripping a heavy brass candlestick like a weapon, scanning the dark corners of the room. Sachin swallows hard, trying to project a calm he doesn't feel, before rubbing his face in fatigue and waving a dismissive, trembling hand toward the hallway.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (വിറയാർന്ന ശബ്ദത്തിൽ, ചുറ്റും നോക്കിക്കൊണ്ട്) ഇപ്പോൾ പുറത്തിറങ്ങാൻ പറ്റില്ല... ബാക്കി ഒക്കെ നാളെ നോക്കാം.
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Maintaining the breathless, high-tension momentum from the previous shot, the camera pans smoothly from Sachin’s exhausted, sweating face as he waves off the night's terrors, to Reenu. Still clutching the heavy brass candlestick defensively, her sharp eyes catch a faint glimmer of yellowed paper resting under the flickering glow of an antique oil lamp on the writing desk. Kneeling down cautiously, she uses the tip of the candlestick to flip open the crumpled paper. The warm candlelight dances across her wide, terrified eyes as she reads the eerie Malayalam handwriting. Sachin, still catching his breath, leans heavily over her shoulder, his eyes widening in horror as the cold mountain air fogs slightly between them.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: (വിറയാർന്ന ശബ്ദത്തിൽ, കത്തിലേക്കു ചൂണ്ടിക്കൊണ്ട്) സച്ചിൻ... ഇവിടെ നോക്കൂ... ഒരു കത്ത് കിടക്കുന്നു. 'പഴയ പാലത്തിലേക്ക് പോകരുത്' എന്ന്...!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

episodes.synopsis: Showing the note. Panic running.
episodes.cliffhanger: A loud crash from the forest. Dialogue: 'എന്തോ തകർന്നു!'

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: The camera holds the low-lit, chilling atmosphere of the living room from the previous scene. Reenu still holds the crumpled yellowed note, her face illuminated by the flickering oil lamp. Sachin stands close behind her, rubbing his arms against the biting Munnar cold. Suddenly, Amal stumbles into the frame from the hallway wrapped in a blanket like a ghost, teeth chattering. Reenu looks up from the note with fierce determination, clutching the paper tightly, while Amal gasps in sheer terror at the words.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: (വിറയ്ക്കുന്ന കൈകളോടെ കത്ത് മുറുകെപ്പിടിച്ച്, ദൃഢനിശ്ചയത്തോടെ) 'ഈ കുറിപ്പ് വെറുമൊരു ഭീഷണിയല്ല സച്ചിൻ... ആ പഴയ പാലത്തിൽ എന്തോ ഒളിഞ്ഞിരിപ്പുണ്ട്. നേരം വെളുക്കും മുൻപ് നമ്മൾ അവിടേക്ക് പോയി സത്യം അറിയണം!'
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up of Reenu's determined expression holding the weathered note

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Close-Up (CU), Pixar 3D Camera: Amal freezes mid-step, his eyes widening in sheer panic beneath his blanket-ghost disguise as he processes Reenu's words. He violently shakes his head, dropping his phone onto the sofa cushion with a loud bounce. He grips Sachin's sleeve frantically, his teeth chattering so hard his jaw clicks, frantically trying to talk them out of the suicide mission.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (കരിഞ്ഞ മുഖത്തോടെ, ഫോൺ താഴെയിട്ട്) പാലത്തിലേക്കോ?! ഭ്രാന്താണോ റീനു നിനക്ക്? സന്ധ്യക്ക് ആ വഴിക്ക് പോയാൽ യക്ഷി നമ്മളെ ചതച്ചരച്ച് പൊറോട്ട അടിക്കും! ഞാൻ ഇവിടുന്ന് ഒരിഞ്ചും അനങ്ങില്ല... വേണമെങ്കിൽ ഞാൻ Zomato-യിൽ വല്ല കുഴിമന്തിയും ഓർഡർ ചെയ്യാം, നിങ്ങൾ പോയി കഴിച്ച് തീർക്ക്!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Transition from the misty threshold of the homestay. Sachin and Reenu step out into the freezing night, Sachin pulling his jacket tight before they make their way down to the Old Munnar Suspension Bridge. Low-angle volumetric moonlight cuts through dense, creeping Munnar fog. They step cautiously onto the creaking, moss-covered wooden planks. Sachin’s flashlight beam cuts erratically through the mist, illuminating floating dust motes and dripping dew. He pauses, turning back over his shoulder toward the empty path leading back to the homestay, ensuring Amal isn't cowardly tailing them, before taking Reenu's arm protectively.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (അമൽ ഒളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന വീടിന്റെ നേരെ നോക്കി അമർഷത്തോടെയും ആശ്വാസത്തോടെയും) അവൻ ആ കമ്പിളിപ്പുതപ്പിനടിയിൽ കിടന്ന് വിറച്ചോട്ടെ... പറഞ്ഞിട്ട് കാര്യമില്ല. റീനു, വഴി വല്ലാതെ തെന്നുന്നുണ്ട്, സൂക്ഷിച്ചു നടക്കണേ!
shots.location: Homestay Exterior to Old Munnar Suspension Bridge
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Close-Up (MCU), Pixar 3D Camera: The camera tracks low alongside the swaying wooden planks. Reenu stops abruptly, her breath pluming into the freezing night air as the bridge swings gently in the mountain breeze. Her eyes widen as the sweeping beam of Sachin's flashlight catches a glint of metal tangled in the rusted wire mesh of the handrail. She reaches out a gloved hand, her fingers gently brushing past the frost to touch a tarnished silver locket, her expression shifting from apprehension to intense curiosity.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: (ശബ്ദം താഴ്ത്തി, വിരൽ ചൂണ്ടി) സച്ചിൻ... ആ വെളിച്ചം ഒന്നു കൂടി ഇങ്ങോട്ട് അടിക്കേ! ഈ ലോക്കറ്റിൽ പതിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത്... ആ പഴയ ഡയറിയിലെ അതേ ചിഹ്നമല്ലേ?
shots.location: Old Munnar Suspension Bridge - Exterior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: The camera holds for a beat on Reenu holding the locket, the wind whistling through the bridge cords. Suddenly, a panicked, high-pitched scream cuts through the cold air. The camera whip-pans violently back toward the wooden entrance. Amal comes barreling onto the bridge, his oversized red backpack knocking against the rusted railings, tangling in a hanging creeper. He trips over his own boots, wiping out hard onto the frosty planks, scrambling and flailing like an overturned turtle while pointing frantically backward into the misty tea estates.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (നിലത്തുനിന്ന് കൈകാലുകൾ ഇട്ട് അടിച്ച്, കിതച്ച് കരച്ചിലിന്റെ വക്കിൽ) അയ്യോ നിൽക്കാനൊന്നും പറ്റില്ല! അവിടെ എന്നെ തനിച്ചാക്കി പോന്നതല്ലേ... ദാ, പുറകിൽ ഏതോ ഒരുത്തൻ നമ്മളെ നോക്കി വരുന്നുണ്ട്! ഓടിക്കോ!
shots.location: Old Munnar Suspension Bridge - Exterior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium Close-Up (MCU), Pixar 3D Camera: In the middle of his desperate scramble, Amal dives past Sachin and grabs a heavy, vibrant red backpack hanging on the post—mistaking it for his own. Sachin, eyes wide in absolute disbelief amidst the howling cold wind, violently yanks it back, his face inches from Amal's in a frantic, comedic tug-of-war while a chilling, unnatural rustling sound echoes menacingly from the tea bushes behind them.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (ദേഷ്യത്തോടെ, ബാഗ് പിടിച്ചുവാങ്ങിക്കൊണ്ട്) 'അത് എന്റെ ബാഗാണ്, പൊട്ടാ! അവിടുന്ന് ഏതോ പ്രേതം ചാടിവീഴാൻ നിൽക്കുമ്പോഴാ നിന്റെ ഒരു ബാഗ് പിടുത്തം!'
shots.location: Old Munnar Suspension Bridge - Exterior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Wide to Medium Shot (MS), Pixar 3D Camera: Sweeping low angle as thick, unnaturally cold mountain mist violently surges across the Old Munnar Suspension Bridge, instantly swallowing the lantern light. Sachin and Amal are frozen mid-tug-of-war, their hands locked on the red backpack. The chilling rustle from the tea bushes explodes into a guttural, whispering wind. Reenu snaps her flashlight beam cutting through the whiteout, her eyes darting toward the bushes in pure alarm.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, റീനുവിനെ നോക്കി അലറുന്നു) 'എന്റെ പൊന്നോ... ഇത് സാധാരണ കോടയല്ല! പാലമൊക്കെ ആടുന്നുണ്ട്, വേഗം ഓട്!'
shots.location: Old Munnar Suspension Bridge - Exterior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Close-Up (CU) on Amal, his eyes wide with absolute cartoonish terror, shivering violently. Pixar 3D Camera: Tight angle looking past Reenu's shaking flashlight beam. Amal's trembling, frost-bitten finger stabs frantically into the blinding, churning wall of mist toward the darkened tea bushes, his jaw chattering so hard his teeth click.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, വിരൽ ചൂണ്ടിക്കൊണ്ട്) 'അങ്ങോട്ട്... അങ്ങോട്ട് എന്തോ നമ്മളെ നോക്കുന്നുണ്ട്! എന്റെ അമ്മോ, എന്നെ തിരിച്ചു വിട്!'
shots.location: Old Munnar Suspension Bridge - Exterior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS) tracking Reenu as she abruptly spins around from Amal's pointing finger, her flashlight beam cutting through the dense, swirling Munnar fog. Pixar 3D Camera: Low-angle, dynamic push-in on Reenu's face, her breath fogging in the freezing air. As the ethereal, towering silhouette of the legendary female tea-picker materializes out of the whiteout mist, Reenu’s eyes widen not in blind terror, but in chilling recognition as her silver locket suddenly glows faintly, grounding her in a strange, eerie calm.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: രേണു: (ശബ്‌ദം താഴ്ത്തി, ഗൗരവത്തോടെ) 'അവളല്ല... അത്... അവൾ നമ്മളെ തേടി വന്നതാ.'
shots.location: Old Munnar Suspension Bridge - Exterior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Narrator
shots.action: Wide Shot (WS) shifting to a dramatic high-angle as the suspension bridge violently fractures. Reenu’s eerie calm shatters instantly as the wooden planks beneath them splinter and plunge into the misty gorge. Pixar 3D Camera: Rapid crane down and back, capturing Sachin and Amal grabbing onto the swaying guide ropes while Reenu is jolted back to reality, her flashlight beam spinning wildly into the abyss as the legendary tea-picker vanishes into the rolling whiteout.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: നരേറ്റർ: 'കനത്ത ശബ്ദത്തോടെ ആ പഴയ പാലം താഴെ കൊക്കയിലേക്ക് തകർന്നു വീണു!'
shots.location: Old Munnar Suspension Bridge - Exterior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dramatic wide shot of snapping cables in swirling mist

episodes.synopsis: Taking shelter. Reading clippings.
episodes.cliffhanger: Letter text reveal. Dialogue: 'അവളെ അങ്ങോട്ട് മനപ്പൂർവ്വം കൊണ്ടുവന്നതാണ്.'

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium Close-Up (MCU) shifting to a frantic over-the-shoulder shot. Sachin bursts through the rotting wooden door of an abandoned colonial estate outbuilding, slamming it shut behind a terrified Amal. Sachin's chest heaves violently, his face bathed in the erratic, frantic sweeps of his flashlight beam. He shines it back toward the raging mist outside, screaming Reenu's name into the dark. Amal collapses against a dusty tea crate, hyperventilating. Pixar 3D Camera: Fast handheld push-in matching Sachin's rising panic, capturing sweat dripping from his chin and dust motes swirling in the amber flashlight cone.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (കിതച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, കരച്ചിലിന്റെ വക്കിൽ) റീനു! റീനു എവിടെ?! നമ്മൾ... നമ്മൾ പെട്ടു!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS), tracking Amal's frantic movements in the dusty, amber-lit interior. Fresh from the terror outside, Amal scrambles backward on the floor, tearing open a packet of old, coarse kitchen salt he found on a shelf. His hands shake so violently he spills half of it on his own lap. He begins frantically pouring a shaky, uneven circle on the rotting wooden floorboards around himself and a hyperventilating Sachin, his eyes wide with cartoonish, desperate terror. Pixar 3D Camera: Low-angle dynamic push-in capturing Amal's sweaty, wide-eyed panic as the beam of Sachin's flashlight cuts wildly across the dusty air in the background.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, കരച്ചിൽ കലർന്ന ശബ്ദത്തിൽ) ഇത്... ഇത് സിനിമയിൽ കണ്ടിട്ടുണ്ട്! ഉപ്പ്... ഉപ്പ് ഇട്ടാൽ പ്രേതം വരില്ല! വരാൻ പാടില്ല!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Close-Up (CU) on Sachin inside the trembling, uneven circle of salt. He is leaning back against a rotting wooden crate, chest heaving and flashlight clutched white-knuckled in one hand. He wipes a bead of cold sweat from his forehead with the back of his other hand, looking down at Amal's botched, lumpy salt circle with sheer exasperation through his wide, terrified eyes. Pixar 3D Camera: Tight medium push-in on Sachin's face as he gasps for air, blinking rapidly before delivering his deadpan correction, the amber light casting long, jittery shadows across his expressive features.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (കിതച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, കണ്ണട നേരെയാക്കി) അത്... അത് സിനിമയിലെ മണ്ടത്തരം... ഹു... ഹു... ഉപ്പിട്ടാലൊന്നും യക്ഷികൾ പോവില്ല, അമൽ! അതൊക്കെ വെറും... ഹു... സിനിമാക്കഥയാ!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Medium Shot (MS) tracking Reenu inside the adjoining dust-choked storage room, illuminated by the bobbing beam of her own flashlight. Cobwebs drape over antique tea chests. She startles slightly at the sound of Sachin's breathless voice echoing from the next room, then immediately shines her light down on a peculiar, half-hidden wooden box marked with faded British-era tea estate stamps. Pixar 3D Camera: Low-angle medium shot pushing in past a dusty doorway as Reenu drops to one knee, her eyes widening with a mix of dread and curiosity before she calls out.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: (ശബ്ദം താഴ്ത്തി, ആവേശത്തോടെ) സച്ചിൻ, അമൽ... ഇവിടെ വന്നു നോക്കൂ! ഈ പെട്ടിയിൽ എന്തോ ഉണ്ട്!
shots.location: Abandoned Estate Outbuilding - Storage Room Interior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Medium Close-Up (MCU) tracking Sachin as he bursts through the dusty doorway, panting and shining his flashlight over Reenu's shoulder. His eyes widen in the beam's harsh glare as he spots the open wooden box. Kneeling beside her, his gloved fingers trembling slightly, he reaches into the box and pulls out yellowed, brittle British-era newspaper clippings, squinting at the faded headlines under the flickering white light. Pixar 3D Camera: Dynamic push-in over Sachin's shoulder, capturing the dust motes dancing in the flashlight beam and the genuine suspense etched onto his face.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (ശ്വാസം എടുത്തുക്കൊണ്ട്, വിറയാർന്ന ശബ്ദത്തിൽ) ഇത്... ഇത് സാധാരണ ചായത്തോട്ടത്തിന്റെ രേഖകളല്ല. നോക്കൂ, ഇതിൽ എന്തോ വലിയൊരു രഹസ്യമുണ്ട്!
shots.location: Abandoned Estate Outbuilding - Storage Room Interior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Wide Angle (W/A) framing the dark, rotting doorway behind Sachin and Reenu. Amal is pressed flat against the doorframe, his knees knocking so violently they create a rhythmic clacking sound. He holds his flashlight at an awkward, trembling angle, casting frantic, erratic beams across the cobweb-draped ceiling. Hearing Sachin's urgent voice, Amal lets out a high-pitched squeak, pulling his jacket collar high over his ears while clutching a rusty garden trowel like a medieval broadsword. Pixar 3D Camera: Low-angle medium shot looking up past Amal's trembling frame, emphasizing his comical, exaggerated dread against the looming doorway as a sudden, freezing gust of Munnar mountain wind whips through the broken window panes, making his flashlight beam strobe wildly.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, തൊണ്ടയിൽ കുടുങ്ങിയ ശബ്ദത്തിൽ) അ... അയ്യോ! ദൈവമേ, അതാര്... ആരാണാ ശബ്ദം ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നത്? നമ്മൾ ഇവിടെ പെട്ടുപോയി, ഞാൻ പറഞ്ഞതല്ലേ ഇവിടെ വരരുതെന്ന്!
shots.location: Abandoned Estate Outbuilding - Storage Room Interior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium tracking shot pivoting from Amal's trembling form to Reenu. Reenu firmly pushes past Amal's shaking shoulder, unfazed by his whimpering. She shines her flashlight down onto a weathered, half-eaten wooden desk covered in dust. With sharp, focused eyes, she picks up a yellowed, handwritten letter resting beside a dried-up old inkwell. Dust motes swirl dramatically in the beam of her flashlight as she scans the faded Malayalam cursive with intense, unblinking concentration.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: (അമലിന്റെ വടിയും പേടിയും വകവെയ്ക്കാതെ, ഗൗരവത്തോടെ) അമൽ, ഒന്ന് വായും പൊത്തി മിണ്ടാതിരിക്ക്! അവിടുത്തെ പേടിപെട്ടി തുറക്കൽ നിർത്തിയിട്ട് ഇവിടെ വന്നു നോക്ക്... ആരോ അവളെ ചതിച്ചു, ഈ കത്തിൽ വ്യക്തമായി എഴുതിയിട്ടുണ്ട്.
shots.location: Abandoned Estate Outbuilding - Storage Room Interior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium two-shot, pushing in slightly as Sachin steps firmly beside Reenu, brushing a thick layer of dust off the edge of the desk. The cold moonlight through the cracked window and the harsh beam of the flashlight create a dramatic contrast on their faces. Sachin narrows his eyes, looking intently at the faded Malayalam cursive in Reenu's hand, his initial anxiety replaced by a firm, protective resolve.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: നമുക്ക് സത്യം അറിയണം. ആത്മഹത്യയല്ല… കൊലപാതകമാണെന്ന് തോന്നുന്നു.
shots.location: Abandoned Estate Outbuilding - Storage Room Interior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium shot tracking Amal as he nervously steps into the sliver of moonlight from behind a towering stack of rotting crates. His eyes are wide with residual terror, his knees visibly knocking together, yet he puffs out his chest with a comically pathetic display of false bravery, clutching a rusty old umbrella like a wizard's staff.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ഞാൻ... ഞാൻ കൂടെയുണ്ട്! പേടിച്ചിട്ടൊന്നുമല്ല... നിങ്ങളെ ഒറ്റക്ക് വിടാൻ വയ്യാഞ്ഞിട്ടാ!
shots.location: Abandoned Estate Outbuilding - Storage Room Interior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Narrator
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Close-up tracking shot. As Amal strikes a ridiculous pose with his umbrella, a sudden, chilly gust of wind blows through a broken window, scattering a cloud of dust. Reenu steps past Amal, shining her phone flashlight onto an old, dust-covered wooden desk. Resting right in the center is a weathered, half-opened envelope. Reenu's small hand reaches down, gently pulling out a yellowed handwritten letter as the camera pushes in sharply on the chilling Malayalam handwriting.
shots.location: Abandoned Estate Outbuilding - Storage Room Interior Night
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

episodes.synopsis: Confronting the caretaker. Amal's theory is absurd.
episodes.cliffhanger: Door creaks. Dialogue: 'വാതിൽ തുറക്കുന്നു.'

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium tracking shot, dusk bleeding into dark blue night. The wooden front door of the homestay flies open with a sharp creak. Sachin and Reenu stumble inside, chest heaving, eyes wide with residual adrenaline and terror. Reenu's knuckles are white as she clutches the yellowed letter from the estate. Sachin slams the door shut, turns around, and slams the silver locket and the terrifying Malayalam letter down onto the wooden dining table right in front of a startled, pale-faced Caretaker Sreedharan. Warm lamplight casts long, dramatic shadows across Sreedharan's guilty, sweating face.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ശ്രീധരൻ ചേട്ടാ, ഇനി ഒന്നും മറയ്ക്കരുത്... ഈ ലോക്കറ്റും കത്തും എന്താണെന്ന് സത്യം പറയൂ!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Caretaker
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium-close, dynamic push-in framing Sachin and Reenu leaning over the dining table, chests still heaving from their sprint through the tea estate. Sreedharan flinches violently back at the slam, his wide eyes darting from the blood-stained silver locket to the yellowed Malayalam letter. The warm lamplight highlights the cold sweat beading on his forehead. Trembling, Sreedharan's old hands slide off the table as he slowly slumps backward onto an antique wooden chair, completely cornered by the truth.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അന്ന് ആ രാത്രിയിൽ നടന്ന ചതി അവൾ അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നു... ആ പാപം ഇന്നും ഈ മൂന്നാറിനെ വിട്ടുപോയിട്ടില്ല.
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Over-the-shoulder medium shot from Sachin’s perspective, focusing on Reenu. Reenu’s hair is slightly disheveled from their sprint through the tea estate, and her eyes remain fixed with a mix of shock and intuitive realization on the blood-stained locket. She grips the edge of the antique table tightly, her knuckles white, her chest still rising and falling rapidly. In the soft, atmospheric lamplight, she leans forward slightly toward the collapsed caretaker, her voice trembling yet sharp with sudden deduction.
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium close-up tracking shot. The camera tracks Reenu’s trembling hand pointing at the locket, then whip-pans across the antique dining table to Amal. Amal flinches backward in terror, nearly tipping over his brass teacup into a spilled pool of chai. His eyes bulge wide behind his round spectacles as he stammers, frantically shuffling through a scattered pile of old estate ledger papers with ink-stained fingers. In his hyperactive panic, he bumps his head against the wood-paneled wall, wincing briefly before his face lights up with sudden, chaotic inspiration.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: എനിക്ക് മനസ്സിലായി! ഇത്... ഇത് ആ ഡയറിയിലെ രണ്ടാമത്തെ പേജുമായി എന്തോ ബന്ധമുണ്ട്!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Over-the-shoulder medium shot from Amal's frantic perspective. Sachin sits across the cluttered dining table, casually sipping his sulaimani tea, completely unfazed by Amal's theatrical outburst. Sachin lets out a soft, tired sigh, lowering his glass with a tiny *clink* on the brass saucer. He gestures dismissively with one hand toward the messy stack of papers, his brow furrowed in good-natured exasperation.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അതല്ല അമൽ, നീ വെറുതെ ഓരോന്ന് കൂട്ടി വായിക്കുകയാ.
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Caretaker
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium-close up, tracking the rapid motion as Caretaker Sreedharan suddenly bursts into the dining room from the kitchen shadows, gasping for breath. He lunges across the cluttered table, his weathered, trembling hands tightly gripping Sachin's forearm. Sachin's eyes widen in mild shock, hot sulaimani tea sloshing slightly over the brim of his glass. Amal shrieks softly and jumps back in his chair, spilling a pencil holder. Sreedharan's face is illuminated by the warm, flickering yellow glow of the dining room's brass lantern, casting long, dramatic shadows against the wood-paneled walls.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: കെയർടേക്കർ: 'അതല്ല സാറെ... വെറുതെ പറയുന്നതല്ല! ഇന്ന് അർദ്ധരാത്രി അവൾ പഴയ ഫാക്ടറിയിലെ നിലവറയിലേക്ക് പോകും... ആ രേഖ നിങ്ങൾ എടുത്തേ പറ്റൂ, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ പിന്നെ രക്ഷയില്ല!'
shots.camera_hint: Dramatic 3D two-shot with flickering hall shadows illuminating Sreedharan's terrified face

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium shot, tracking from Sreedharan's gripping hands to Sachin's face. Suddenly, with a loud electrical pop, the brass lantern's flame is violently extinguished by a sudden, freezing gust of wind whistling through the wooden window shutters. Complete, pitch-black darkness envelops the frame for a split second, broken only by Sachin's wide eyes catching the faint, eerie blue moonlight filtering through the misty glass. Sachin freezes, his breath fogging in the sudden chill, while Amal's frantic hands immediately claw at Sachin's shoulder in the dark, knocking over a ceramic tea plate with a sharp crash.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: 'ഛെ... വീണ്ടും കറന്റ് പോയോ?! കെയർടേക്കറെ, പിടT... കൈ വിടൂ, ഇരുട്ടിൽ തപ്പിക്കളിക്കാതെ!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Close-up, pushing in rapidly on Amal’s terrified face illuminated only by the cold, eerie blue moonlight cutting through the window. Amal is crouched low, eyes squeezed shut, desperately clinging to Sachin's jacket sleeve as ceramic shards from the broken tea plate scatter around their feet. His chest heaves violently, breath fogging in the freezing air.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: എന്നെ രക്ഷിക്കണേ! ആരോ... ആവോ എന്തോ കട്ടിലിനടിയിൽ... കാറ്റ്... കാറ്റല്ല, അതൊരു കൈയ്യായിരുന്നു!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium shot, tracking fast with Reenu as she whips around from the hallway entrance. Her breath fogs visibly in the plunging temperature. She grips her heavy brass flashlight like a club, her eyes wide with sudden alertness but grounded focus. She thrusts her arm out, cutting a beam of warm yellow light through the chilling blue moonlight to illuminate Amal cowering on the floor and Sachin trying to shield him. She tilts her head sharply, freezing as a heavy, dragging thud echoes from the ceiling directly above them.
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Narrator
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Low-angle medium shot, looking past Reenu’s shoulder. Her brass flashlight's warm beam suddenly flickers and shrinks, choked by a sudden, unnatural wave of inky blackness rolling across the room from the doorway. The front door handle violently rattles, and the heavy wooden hinges groan open as the freezing mist billows inward, extinguishing the remaining amber glow.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: നരേറ്റർ: 'പാതിരാത്രിയുടെ കൊടുംകാറ്റിൽ, വീടിന്റെ മുൻവാതിൽ പതുക്കെ തുറക്കപ്പെട്ടു!'
shots.camera_hint: Creeping point-of-view shot moving toward the open doorway into the night storm

episodes.synopsis: Entering the factory. Building starts to collapse.
episodes.cliffhanger: Seeing the ghost in the photo. Dialogue: 'അയ്യോ! ഇത് ആരാ?'

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Fast-paced, disorienting whip-pan tracking shot. Emerging straight from the blinding, freezing mist of the homestay threshold, Sachin, Reenu, and a whimpering Amal burst tumbling down the mossy stone steps into the tea factory courtyard. Sachin slams the massive, rusted iron doors of the damp factory shut behind them, throwing his entire weight against the bolts as shadow-claws scrape frantically on the exterior wood. The camera spins rapidly inside the subterranean gloom to capture their wide, terrified eyes illuminated only by jittery, crisscrossing flashlight beams. Amal is hyperventilating, clutching a stray tea leaf branch like a talisman, while Sachin leans against the vibrating door, chest heaving, pointing a shaking beam deep into the echoing labyrinth of antique brass machinery.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: 'വാതിൽ അടഞ്ഞു! ശ്വാസം അടക്കിപ്പിടിച്ച് ഒതുങ്ങിനിൽക്ക്... ശ്രീധരൻ പറഞ്ഞ രഹസ്യ നിലവറ ഇതാണ്! ആ ഒറിജിനൽ രേഖ കണ്ടെത്തി ആ ആത്മാവിന് നീതി വാങ്ങിക്കൊടുക്കണം!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic high-contrast tracking shot through decaying factory machinery and swirling mist

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium-wide shot. The heavy iron door rattles violently from an unseen force outside. Sachin frantically throws a rusted iron latch over the handles, sealing it shut, while Amal collapses onto a wooden crate, hyperventilating into a paper bag. Amidst the billowing, sub-zero mist of the massive tea-processing machinery floor, a soft, ethereal turquoise glow cuts through the darkness. The translucent figure of Bhadra materializes, hovering near an ancient brass rolling machine. Reenu, still panting slightly from the run, gently pushes past Sachin's outstretched arm. Her eyes soften with profound empathy. She steps forward, her flashlight lowered, addressing the heartbroken spirit with steady, comforting grace.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: 'പേടിക്കണ്ട ഭദ്രാ... ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളെ ഉപദ്രവിക്കാൻ വന്നതല്ല, ആ രേഖകൾ കണ്ടെത്തി നീതി നേടിത്തരാൻ വന്നതാണ്.'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Close-up tracking shot on Amal. He's still clutching the crumpled paper bag in one hand while his other hand shakes violently, trying to keep a heavy-duty industrial flashlight steady on the glowing, translucent figure of Bhadra across the misty floor. His wide, terrified eyes dart between the ghost and Sachin. He takes a shaky, hyperventilating gulp of air, adjusting his glasses which are fogging up from the freezing factory mist, forcing a brave front that cracks completely.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: 'ഞാൻ... ഞാൻ റെഡിയാണ്! പക്ഷേ ആ വെളിച്ചം എന്നെ നോക്കി ഒന്നു മീശ പിരിക്കാൻ പറഞ്ഞേക്കരുത് കേട്ടോ!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium-wide dynamic tracking shot. Amidst the freezing, mist-choked factory floor where Bhadra's translucent figure hums with an unearthly blue light, Sachin ignores the terror, diving desperately beneath the dripping, rusted gears of the primary tea press. His hands scramble frantically against the freezing ironwork until they snap open a hidden brass compartment, yanking out the heavy, yellowed, wax-sealed 1994 estate deed. Just feet away, Bhadra's head snaps 180 degrees toward Sachin with a spine-chilling metallic screech. Amal shrieks in absolute terror, accidentally firing his heavy-duty flashlight directly into Sachin's eyes while sobbing uncontrollably.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (കിതച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, രേഖ ഉയർത്തിക്കാട്ടുന്നു) 'ഇതാ അത്! മുപ്പതു വർഷമായി ഈ ഭൂതത്തിന്റെ കീഴിൽ ഒളിച്ചുവെച്ച ആ ഒറിജിനൽ രേഖ! അമൽ, കണ്ണ് തുറന്ന് പിട്രാ ലൈറ്റ് അങ്ങോട്ട് അടിക്ക്!!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Narrator
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Low-angle chaotic push-in, shaking violently as massive chunks of the rusted tin roof tear away. The unearthly blue glow of Bhadra pulses violently, sending a shockwave that shatters the old factory windows. Sachin stumbles backward out from under the tea press, clutching the yellowed deed to his chest just as a heavy iron beam crashes down right where he was standing. Reenu lunges forward through the swirling mist and debris, grabbing Sachin’s collar and hauling him upright. Amal is on his knees, weeping hysterically and gripping a falling sack of tea leaves as dust and freezing Munnar rain pour through the fractured ceiling.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: റീനു: (ശബ്‌ദമുയർത്തി, ഭയത്തോടെ) 'സച്ചിൻ, സൂക്ഷിച്ച്! മേൽക്കൂര താഴെ വീഴുന്നു! വേഗം പുറത്തേക്ക് ഓടൂ!!'
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium-wide tracking shot, spinning dynamically to capture the howling wind and driving rain lashing into the ruined factory floor. Amal, his clothes caked in white tea dust and trembling violently, lunges toward the jammed side-door. He throws his entire weight against the rusted panic bar, slipping on wet tea leaves before finally popping the heavy iron door open. He extends a frantic, shaking hand back toward Sachin and Reenu, his eyes wide with cartoonish terror as another section of the roof groans above them.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, കരച്ചിലിന്റെ വക്കിൽ) അയ്യോ ദൈവമേ, നമ്മൾ തീർന്നു! ഇങ്ങോട്ട് ഓടി വാടാ, വേഗം!!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Close-up tracking shot moving fast from Amal's outstretched hand to Sachin and Reenu. Sachin's face is illuminated by a sharp flash of Munnar lightning, his eyes wide with protective grit. He grips Reenu's hand so tightly his knuckles turn white, forcefully yanking her forward through the slamming, wind-whipped doorway just as a massive sheet of corrugated iron crashes down right where they were standing a second ago. Reenu stumbles over the wet threshold, gasping for breath.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (കിതച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, റീനുവിന്റെ കൈയിൽ പിടിച്ച് വലിച്ചുകൊണ്ട്) നിൽക്കാന நேரമില്ല, ഓടിക്കോ!!
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic cinematic 3D medium shot

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium shot inside the cramped, fog-streaked interior of Amal's car. Rain violently lashes the windshield. Amal is slumped over the steering wheel, wiping sweat from his forehead with a shaking hand, breathing heavily. Suddenly, the rear door is yanked open by Sachin, who shoves a drenched, shivering Reenu into the back seat before diving in himself, slamming the door shut against the howling Munnar gale. Amal turns around, eyes wide with residual terror, blinking through his fogged-up glasses.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, സ്റ്റിയറിംഗിൽ പിടിമുറുക്കി) ദൈവമേ... നമ്മൾ ജീവനോടെ ഉണ്ടാകുമെന്ന് ഞാൻ കരുതിയില്ല! ഇനി... ഇനി നമുക്ക് എങ്ങനെയെങ്കിലും ഇവിടെനിന്ന് കടന്നുകളയാം!
shots.location: Car - Interior / Factory Parking Lot - Night
shots.camera_hint: Interior car medium shot, dynamic angle

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Close-up inside the dark, fogged-up car interior, illuminated only by the amber glow of the dashboard and sudden flashes of lightning through the rain-streaked windows. Sachin is hunched in the front passenger seat, chest heaving, water dripping from his drenched hair onto his jacket. His fingers tremble slightly as he holds up the old, rain-spotted black-and-white photograph. In the background, Reenu is shivering violently, wrapped in a blanket in the back seat, gasping for air. Sachin stares down at the photo with a grim, exhausted expression, trying to process what just happened.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ: (കിതച്ചുകൊണ്ട്, ശബ്ദം താഴ്ത്തി) ഇല്ല... അമൽ പറയുന്നതാ ശരി. നമ്മൾ വിചാരിച്ചത്ര എളുപ്പമല്ല ഇത്. പക്ഷേ... ഈ ഫോട്ടോയിലുള്ള രഹസ്യം നമ്മൾ കണ്ടുപിടിക്കണം.
shots.location: Car - Interior / Factory Parking Lot - Night
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up with expressive emotional focus

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Pixar 3D Camera: Medium-close shot inside the rain-lashed car. The amber glow from the dashboard reflects off Sachin's exhausted, wet face as he stares at the old photograph. Suddenly, with a sharp *click-hum*, the car's overhead cabin lights flicker violently to life, casting an eerie, harsh white glare over the interior. From the driver's seat, Amal yelps in high-pitched terror, dropping the car keys into the footwell as he fumbles wildly. He snatches up his smartphone, its bright screen illuminating his bulging, cartoonish Pixar eyes and hanging jaw. He shoves the phone toward Sachin and Reenu. In the background, Reenu drops her blanket, and both lean in, their eyes locking onto the phone screen in sheer horror: a faint, translucent, grinning silhouette of Bhadra is digitally photobombed right between them in the backseat mirror reflection.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: അമൽ: (തൊണ്ടയിടറി, വെപ്രാളത്തോടെ) അയ്യോ ദൈവമേ! വണ്ടി പെട്ടെന്ന് ഡെഡ് ആയി... പിന്നെന്താ ഈ ഫോണിൽ കാണിക്കുന്നത്?! നമ്മുടെ കൂടെ... ആ കട്ടിലിൽ കിടന്ന ആ കൊച്ച്... പിന്നേയും നമ്മളെ ഫോളോ ചെയ്യുവാ!
shots.location: Car - Interior / Factory Parking Lot - Night
shots.camera_hint: Interior car comedic two-shot shifting focus from phone selfie to Amal's jaw-dropping reaction

flattened_shots.speaker: Narrator
flattened_shots.action: A wide, warm Pixar-style cinematic shot of a cozy Munnar living room bathed in golden morning mist filtering through large glass windows. Sachin stands center-stage, bursting with infectious energy, clutching a weathered, hand-drawn map with dramatic flair. He points excitedly at a circled location. Reenu sits on a vintage wooden sofa nearby, sipping chaya from a clay cup, pausing mid-sip with a raised eyebrow and an amused, skeptical smile, looking at a packed suitcase by the door.
flattened_shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up with expressive emotional focus

flattened_shots.speaker: Sachin
flattened_shots.action: Close-up on Sachin as he springs across the cozy living room in a exaggerated, theatrical glide, planting both hands on the coffee table right in front of Reenu. He unfurls a glitter-decorated, color-coded 'Couples Adventure Itinerary' that unrolls like a cartoon scroll onto the floor. Sachin flashes a wide, toothy, hyper-optimistic Pixar grin, his expressive eyes wide with desperate romance. Reenu calmly sets her clay chaya cup down on a wooden coaster, her right eyebrow still arched playfully, peering down at the absurdly detailed schedule with a deadpan, unimpressed tilt of her head.
